Sophie — thanks for the note and the term sheet. High-level reactions from Redwood: we like the alignment but need to tighten a few operational points before committing to the 60/40 for both implementation and recurring revenue.

Operational items we need to resolve:
- Revenue split clarity: Redwood prefers a differentiated split by revenue type (implementation vs recurring SaaS seats). Suggestion: 70/30 AstraWorks/Redwood on implementation fees (partner leads), 60/40 Redwood/AstraWorks on recurring hosted inference revenue where Redwood provides tokens and hosting (we need to protect our unit economics).
- Trial credits: We can provide token credits for POCs but need to limit per-company aggregate credits and require an intake form + tracking tag. Proposal: 200k token credits per POC, up to 3 POCs per account within 120 days, tracked via a co-signed MAP (mutual action plan).
- Lead protection: 90-day registration is OK but must be backed by proof of introduction (email thread or signed MAP) to avoid disputes. We also need a triage step in Partner Ops for duplicates.
- Routing & priority: we can offer a limited priority capacity window for initial POCs (2-week burst) subject to capacity and Dedicated pool reservations.

I've annotated the attached term sheet with these items — see page 2-3. If this direction looks reasonable we can involve Legal + Partner Ops and produce a Redwood-side redline.

Karthik

- Commercial: blended 65/35 AstraWorks/Redwood on implementation + year-1 recurring for partner-originated deals (pilot definition: first 18 months), then revert to the baseline differentiated split (70/30 impl; 60/40 recurring) for renewals unless otherwise negotiated.
- Trial credits: Redwood will provide up to 200k token credits per POC. Unused credits expire 45 days after allocation. Partners may request up to 3 POCs per account within a 120-day window. Credits are tracked via intake form + partner tag.

- Capacity & routing: Redwood will grant a 2-week priority burst for the POC subject to Dedicated pool reservation confirmation; ops will confirm capacity within 3 business days of intake.

3) AstraWorks to confirm whether the blended 65/35 is acceptable and share a DocuSign link for the pilot MAP.
